id: title:andyzzhao:move query log archive export ownership to analytics platform

review.posthog_relevance: Potential change in ownership accountability for query log archival workflow, though no implementation or behavior change is demonstrated.
review.reason: Only a metadata tag change is supplied; no implementation, behavior or PostHog mechanism is demonstrated. The score is assigned conservatively as tier 1 because the change is a localized metadata update without demonstrated behavioral or systemic impact.
review.uncertainty: The actual operational or reliability benefit is unverified; this could be a trivial ownership record update or a precursor to a larger change. No execution, recovery, or correctness improvement is shown.
